chapter: Records, Blanton, the Chicago scene, Nat Cole and Nadine
title: Playing with Punch Miller, Charles Elgar and Rip Bassett
summary: Names the older Chicago players he worked with.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Then I worked -- not for, but with the legendary Punch Miller, with the All Stars on 43rd Street in Chicago. I forget who had the band, but he would always -- he was a fixture there. He'd play there all the time. But I never knew that Punch had the historic background that he had till this book came out on

his life, whatnot, and Charles Elgar -- he's an old timer, I worked with him, and Clarence Black, used to have the pit band at the Metropole Theatre across the street from the Regal, Jimmy Smith -- Jimmy Bell, I mean, and Rip Bassett. Rip Bassett was a guitarist that had worked with Eddie South.
